thread:
Zoe: Heads-up: noticed negative-looking cache savings on the unit-econ card for tenant: acme-inc during a short prefetch burst (saw warm_hit counts but 'net_savings' went down). Anyone else?
Marcus: Hmm that's odd. Negative net_savings usually means the amortized cost added more than cache saved. Which panel/time?
Zoe: 4988880000-4988881200 window, per-route panel for /api/chat. Warm_hit tokens are high, but the patch-level savings ribbon dips below 0 for ~40s.
Yara: Could be double-charging: if prefetch credits are applied to a later invocation but amortization window is wrong we might be subtracting credits then recharging later.
Marcus: Quick check I ran:
```
SELECT sum(warm_tokens) as warm, sum(prefetch_credited) as prefetch, sum(model_charge) as charge
FROM token_events
WHERE ts BETWEEN 4988879800 AND 4988881400
AND route = '/api/chat';
```
Result: warm=12,200, prefetch=0, charge=3,400 tokens-equivalent.
Zoe: prefetch=0 despite warm_hits present. So credits not emitted or got filtered.
infra-bot: deploy 4988881300 - prefetch-reconcilier v0.5 -> v0.6 (flag: amortize_prefetch=true).
Priya: That deploy was the canary we rolled last night. Might be related. v0.6 changes amortization windows to be session-anchored which can cause mismatch when sessions churn quickly.
Yara: If session IDs rotate mid-prefetch, amortized credits may be queued and then dropped if session TTL expired. Two fixes: 1) emit provisional prefetch credits keyed by batch_id, or 2) change amortization to use route-level open window instead of session-anchored.
Lin: UX note: customers see "negative" net_savings and assume billing bug. We should show an explanatory note when amortized credits lag by >30s and show both raw warm_tokens and credited_prefetch lines on hover.
Marcus: For immediate mitigation: roll prefetch-reconciler flag back to v0.5 (disable amortize_prefetch) and emit provisional credits for any warm_hits during the burst.
infra-bot: rollback 4988881325 - prefetch-reconciler v0.6 -> v0.5 (auto-rollback executed).
Zoe: Rollback done. Can we add an alert when warm_tokens_per_min > 2k and prefetch_credited_ratio < 10% for >20s so ops can triage faster?
Priya: Yes, I'll add that rule. Also we should annotate dashboard data with reconciler_version so customers can see which code produced the numbers.
Yara: Implementation plan: (A) emit provisional prefetch credits with batch_id and provisional=true as interim, (B) reconciler later reconciles/dedupe when session mapping stabilizes, (C) tag metrics with reconciler_version. Provisional emits should be cheap: 1 row per batch.
Marcus: Agree. Also add a small "explain" chip on the unit-econ card when provisional credits are present that links to a short modal explaining amortization semantics.
Lin: I'll draft copy for the chip: "Credits provisional — amortization in-flight. Click to learn why values may be temporarily low or negative." Keep copy accessible and include reconciler_version.
Zoe: Tests: Marcus can run a staging burst that simulates rapid session churn and confirm provisional emits show up and final reconciled credits converge to raw warm within 2 mins.
Marcus: I'll script a 5-minute zig-zag to 5x baseline with session rotation and post results.
Priya: I'll own alerting and the reconciler_version tag in metrics. Yara, can you land the provisional emit patch with TTL and a dedupe key?
Yara: Yep — will add batch_id, provisional=true, reconciler_version in emission rows and a 10m TTL. Will also add a small metrics counter credit_emits_provisional. Estimate ship in ~90 mins.
Zoe: Thanks. Action items: rollback confirmed, provisional emit patch (Yara), staging test (Marcus), alert + metrics tag (Priya), UX chip copy (Lin). Will keep thread updates here. :thumbsup:
